ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems (AMS) issued a clarification stating that a recent High Court judgment largely favored the company concerning a challenged defense contract award, explicitly refuting a news headline about a "₹1 bid" as unrelated to their operations. The ruling upheld AMS's tender award and financial approval, which remain valid pending only a routine pre-award verification, significantly reducing uncertainty regarding the contract's future. AMS further clarified its competitive pricing stemmed from prior investments in indigenous technology development on a no-cost basis, effectively validating its bid's legitimacy and mitigating any perceived financial red flags.
